id: Close Encounters of the Third Kind (1977)

facts.text: Look at this plate of mashed potatoes. I know this shape. I just can't say from where.
facts.why: Not a Roy line. His real line, from the quote page, is 'I know what this is! This means something. This is important.' Printed in quote marks and signed Roy Neary.
facts.fix: I know what this is! This means something. This is important.

vibe.verdict: Good mash mountain and five-note crackers, but the cafe tone is generic and the quote is made up.
